description: Master v4 - basado en v3 ganadora (3/4) con 5 correcciones: borla TRICOLOR Ecuador en ambas antenas, logo ECUANUTRITION wordmark en cinturon, tipografia ECUAMAN premium en relieve metalico, cola solida no plumas, patas articuladas no plumas
prompt: Recreate this exact ECUAMAN character keeping the same identity, body shape, three-quarter pose, cape, and trident. PRESERVE: the orange Penaeus vannamei segmented body hex F39A2B, the curved shrimp posture, the heroic muscular cephalothorax, the royal blue cape hex 0046AD, the cyan trident hex 00D9FF in his hand, the friendly proud smile. APPLY THESE FIVE PIXEL-PERFECT FIXES, no exceptions: (1) ECUADORIAN FLAG TASSELS on BOTH antenna tips - each antenna ends in IDENTICAL tassel made of THREE flat ribbons stacked vertically in this EXACT order from top to bottom: YELLOW ribbon hex FFDD00 on top, BLUE ribbon hex 003893 in the middle, RED ribbon hex CE1126 at the bottom (the punta). All three ribbons same length around 12 percent of body height, flat like little flags, tied with a small visible BROWN LEATHER KNOT hex 5C3A1E at the base where they meet the antenna. The tassel must look like a tiny Ecuadorian flag hanging from each antenna - both antennas with the SAME tassel, not just one. (2) BELT WORDMARK upgrade: replace the simple letter E medallion with the corporate ECUANUTRITION wordmark - a circular gold-bordered medallion hex F2C744 containing the typographic word 'ECUANUTRITION' arched around the inside of the gold ring in clean modern white sans-serif capitals, with a small stylized cyan ocean wave in the center of the medallion. (3) BELT TEXT 'ECUAMAN' upgrade: rendered in PREMIUM 3D METALLIC RELIEF, like polished chrome embossed letters that catch the light, sharp Bebas Neue or Bank Gothic style condensed bold capitals, white with subtle metallic gold edge highlights, deep shadow underneath for depth, perfectly sharp readable, arched along the bottom curve of the belt. Looks like a real superhero belt buckle, not flat printed text. (4) TAIL must be SOLID and ARTICULATED: the abdomen ends in a clear telson (central pointed segment) plus uropods (two pairs of flat lateral fins) forming a fan that looks like SEGMENTED CHITIN ARMOR, NOT feathers, NOT soft plumes, NOT brushes - hard solid orange shell pieces with visible hard edges and the same hex 5C3A1E segmentation lines. (5) LATERAL LEGS must be SOLID and ARTICULATED: the small pereiopod legs along the sides under the arms must look like REAL ARTICULATED CRUSTACEAN LEGS with visible joints and small chitin segments, hard solid orange material, NOT feathery, NOT plume-like, NOT brushy. Three pairs of solid jointed legs minimum. KEEP: deep Pacific Ocean background, god rays, cinematic lighting, Pixar DreamWorks 3D semi-realistic style, sharp focus, vibrant saturated colors. Vertical full body composition matching the reference exactly.
